post.description:
Real (binary-capable) document upload — the counterpart to
`/rag/text` for files that aren't pasted text: PDF, DOCX, and anything
else `krutrim_agent_doc`'s parser registry supports. The file's
extension is preserved (unlike `/rag/text`'s hardcoded `.txt`) so
`process_rag_document`'s Celery task can dispatch to the right parser
by suffix. Dispatches the same task and job-id scheme as `/rag/text` —
ingestion is unified once content is on disk.

ActivityMessage.title: ActivityMessage
ActivityMessage.description: An activity progress message emitted between chat messages.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description:
A named instance of a registered `AgentProfile`, living inside exactly one project.
Multiple `Agent` rows can share the same `agent_key`, distinguished by `display_name`.

AgentSandboxPolicyUpdate.title: AgentSandboxPolicyUpdate
AgentSandboxPolicyUpdate.description:
Unset (`None`) fields are left unchanged. `sharing=None` means "inherit
the project's default" and is a valid, meaningful value here — unlike
`Project`/`Session`, `Agent.sandbox_sharing` defaults to `None`, not
`"isolated"` — but this route's own partial-update convention still
treats an *omitted* field as "leave unchanged," so explicitly resetting
an agent back to "inherit" isn't possible via this route today (same
known gap as `Storage.update_project_sandbox_policy`).

BinaryInputContent.title: BinaryInputContent
BinaryInputContent.description: A deprecated binary payload reference in a multimodal user message.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description:
A lightweight, non-agentic chat thread. `project_id` is optional; a standalone chat
has no meaningful sandbox policy until moved into a project.

ChatApiMessage.title: ChatApiMessage
ChatApiMessage.description:
One turn's worth of chat history — matches `shared-types.ts`'s
`ChatApiMessage` and `chat/messages.py::from_lc_messages`'s output
exactly. Used both by `POST /api/chat`'s reply and
`GET /api/sessions/{id}/messages`'s history.

ChatSandboxPolicyUpdate.title: ChatSandboxPolicyUpdate
ChatSandboxPolicyUpdate.description:
Unset (`None`) fields are left unchanged. Stored regardless of whether
`project_id` is currently set, but only takes effect once it is — see
`Chat`'s docstring.

FunctionCall.title: FunctionCall
FunctionCall.description: Name and arguments of a function call.

ProjectSandboxPolicyUpdate.title: ProjectSandboxPolicyUpdate
ProjectSandboxPolicyUpdate.description:
Unset (`None`) fields are left unchanged — same partial-update
convention as `update_project`.

ReasoningMessage.title: ReasoningMessage
ReasoningMessage.description: A reasoning message containing the agent's internal reasoning process.

ResumeEntry.title: ResumeEntry
ResumeEntry.description: A per-interrupt response in the resume array of a RunAgentInput.

SessionSandboxPolicyUpdate.title: SessionSandboxPolicyUpdate
SessionSandboxPolicyUpdate.description:
Unset (`None`) fields are left unchanged. There's currently no way to
clear an existing `attached_to_session_id` back to "not attached" through
this route — a real gap, not silently worked around; see
`Storage.update_session_sandbox_policy`'s own docstring.

TextInputContent.title: TextInputContent
TextInputContent.description: A text fragment in a multimodal user message.

ToolCall.title: ToolCall
ToolCall.description: A tool call, modelled after OpenAI tool calls.

UpdateSettingsResponse.title: UpdateSettingsResponse
UpdateSettingsResponse.description:
`settings` stays a free-form dict, not a typed `ModelSettings`
submodel — the actual object is always a provider-specific subclass
(e.g. `OpenRouterModelSettings`), and typing this as the generic base
would make FastAPI silently strip subclass-only fields from the
response, not just the docs.

UserMessage.title: UserMessage
UserMessage.description: A user message supporting text or multimodal content.
